---
title: Positions
---

## Functions

- [`position-dodge`](position-dodge.qmd) - Dodge position adjustment: place grouped bars side by side.
- [`position-fill`](position-fill.qmd) - Fill position adjustment: stack and normalise each x bucket to sum = 1.
- [`position-identity`](position-identity.qmd) - Identity position adjustment: no offset applied to any row.
- [`position-stack`](position-stack.qmd) - Stack position adjustment: cumulate y per x bucket.
